_doc: THE FINALS FIXTURE — which clubs played in each finals week. A home-and-away round needs no entry: all 18 clubs play, so absence is unambiguously a DNP. A finals week does need one, because absence then means two different things (dropped, or your club is not in it) and the scores file alone cannot tell them apart — a club can field a player the store has at another club, and three did in FW1 alone. Feed rounds 25-29 are the finals series; they are LEDGER KEYS for the (player, season, round) dedup, never the calendar. as_of_round HOLDS at 24 throughout the finals.

25.label: FW1
25._note: Four clubs. Melbourne and Collingwood were eliminated here; Western Bulldogs and Carlton went through to FW2.

26.label: FW2
26._note: Eight clubs, owner-declared and independently confirmed by resolving every name in scores/FW2.csv against the store. THREE listed players sit at a ninth, tenth and eleventh club in the store and are NOT evidence those clubs played — Josh Battle (store: St Kilda), Jack Ginnivan (store: Collingwood) and Oscar Allen (store: West Coast) have all since moved to a club that IS in this list. The store's afl_club is an identity field, not a team sheet; it is stale for those three and nothing reads it to price them.

27.label: FW3
27._note: 4 clubs, derived by tools/ingest from scores/resolved/2026_FW3.json: every club carried as afl_club by more than 3 listed players. 1 listed player(s) sit at another club in the store and are NOT evidence that club played — oscar-allen (store: West Coast). The store's afl_club is an identity field, stale for them until the AFL Club courier (ui/tools/ownership_store_apply.py) moves it; nothing reads it to price them.

_shape: THE FINALS SHAPE, OWNER-DECLARED 2026-09-09: FW1 4 clubs, FW2 8, FW3 4, FW4 4, FW5/GF 2. Melbourne and Collingwood were eliminated in week 1; Western Bulldogs and Carlton in week 2. This is the league's own format and it is NOT the AFL's (where week 1 is the wide round) — the four-then-eight opening is why FW2 carries twice FW1's players, and it is recorded here so nobody re-derives it from a score file and concludes a week went missing.
